selection_policy.low_root_selection: dual Top3 protection, original combined score and mean-support threshold
selection_policy.high_root_selection: dual raw-ranker Top3 union only; no score-based additions
selection_policy.low_recursion: original valid-tail gate; recurse with the same fixed top-k
selection_policy.high_recursion: expand every selected root independent of tail capacity
selection_policy.augmentation: source tree plus original TRAIN donor tails; existing 255-column scorer

quality.semantics: Source candidate pool relative quality threshold; no neighbor-first splice protocol

selection_policy.query_tree: same complete selected source tree for training and queries
selection_policy.final_model: unchanged normal-history Huber GMPI; source pair-disjoint validation
